BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BHMCT   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: HMCT   SESSION : MO/2019

SUBJECT : HM7211 RESEARCH PROJECT DESIGN & METHODOLOGY

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Enlist the objectives of research. [2]
 (b) Explain the characteristics of research. [3]


Q2 (a) Describe Descriptive & Analytical Research. [2]
 (b) Distinguish between null & alternate hypothesis. [3]


Q3 (a) Define Research Design. [2]
 (b) Describe research design in descriptive research. [3]


Q4 (a) Distinguish between dependent and independent variables. [2]
 (b) Describe research design in exploratory research. [3]


Q5 (a) Classify secondary data. [2]
 (b) Distinguish between questionnaires & schedules. [3]


Q6 (a) Explain the characteristics of secondary data. [2]
 (b) Describe projective techniques of data collection. [3]
